about: Completion repair, refutation cycle 4 (2026-11-06): the completion corpus re-pinned once on the cycle-4 repair (tests/fixtures/gi4/completion/corpus.json). Every entry whose pinned verdict or reading moved, with its verdict before and after and the mechanism that moved it; measured by ops.gi4.completion --report before --repin. Invariant: no FALSE READY where the installed baseline had none (0). HARNESS.md "Refutation of the integrated diff, cycle 4".

moved.why: the observed-only arm of the removal "not performed" exclusion is abandoned under the two-cycle rule (refutation cycle 4, closed 1 and 2: it excluded supported removals stated in words no list holds, or inside the failure's own passage); a lesion only observed keeps the installed release's hold, so the participant's removal code, admitted by equal eligibility (U8), is held for its performed status and holds the base code beside it - a hold on the safe side, never a false READY; the installed baseline matched only because it did not admit the participant's code.
